definitions.explanation: illegally or improperly changing documents, data, or records

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改竄|かいざん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{公文書|こうぶんしょ}→公文書：11677_koubunsho⟧{改竄|かいざん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重大|じゅうだい}→重大：01641_juudai⟧な⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧だ。
examples.english: Falsification of official documents is a serious crime.

examples.english: Falsification of research data was discovered.

notes:
{改竄|かいざん} refers specifically to fraudulent or illicit alteration of documents or data.

WORD TYPE:
- Noun
- Also used as ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {改竄|かいざん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to falsify)

WRITING:
- {竄|ざん} is a rare kanji meaning "to alter, tamper"
- Often written in mixed script: {改|かい}ざん
- The full kanji form {改竄|かいざん} is more formal

CONNOTATION:
- Always negative/criminal
- Implies deliberate deception
- Not used for legitimate editing

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {改竄|かいざん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to falsify)
- ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧{改竄|かいざん} (data falsification)
- ⟦{公文書|こうぶんしょ}→公文書：11677_koubunsho⟧{改竄|かいざん} (falsification of official documents)
- {改竄|かいざん}{防止|ぼうし} (tamper prevention)
- {改竄|かいざん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}する→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧ (falsification is discovered)

USAGE:
- Government scandals
- Corporate fraud
- Scientific misconduct
- Cybersecurity (data integrity)

NEWS USAGE:
- Very common in political scandals
- 2017-2018 {森友|もりとも}⟦{学園|がくえん}→学園：12272_gakuen⟧ document falsification scandal
- Academic fraud cases

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{偽造|ぎぞう}→偽造：11524_gizou⟧ (forgery - creating fake documents)
- ⟦{捏造|ねつぞう}→捏造：07628_netsuzou⟧ (fabrication - making up entirely)
- ⟦{歪曲|わいきょく}→歪曲：07968_waikyoku⟧ (distortion, misrepresentation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
